What did your workers emit, and how frequently did a client need the combined top-k?

Please include the source count, rank depth, document universe, k, edit shape, CPU/compiler, exact revision and command if available. Which comparator and strategy performed best, and at what percentile? Links to raw timings or a redistributable ID-only replay make the result easier to reproduce.

If the package is in use in a public project, an optional link to the consuming code helps others find an example. Please omit private documents, credentials and internal logs.
